name: Large Pores
description: Large pores are a common skin concern where the openings of hair follicles appear more noticeable on the face and other body parts. This can lead to an open, uneven texture that may make one's complexion look oily or rough.
symptoms: Visible pores on the skin surface
Potential for blackheads and whiteheads in larger pores
risk_factors: Using Products with High Comedogenic Ratings

daily_routine.purpose: Remove dirt, oil, and makeup without stripping the skin.
Gently remove dead skin cells to reduce appearance of pores.
Balance skin pH and prepare it for moisturization.
Keep the skin hydrated without making it appear oily.

lifestyle_tips: Avoiding Picking or Scrubbing Skin Aggressively
common_myths: Larger pores cannot be reduced through skincare routines.
Exfoliating aggressively will make pores smaller.
when_to_consult_doctor: If large pores are accompanied by persistent redness, inflammation, or if you have concerns about bacterial infections in the skin.
prevention: Maintain a consistent and gentle skincare routine
Use oil-free products suitable for your skin type
Protect your skin from sun damage

severity_levels.mild: Visible pores that are not causing significant cosmetic concerns.
severity_levels.moderate: Pores appear larger than average, may cause occasional blackheads or whiteheads but do not significantly disrupt the skin texture.
severity_levels.severe: Very noticeable and potentially problematic for self-esteem, requiring more intensive treatments such as chemical peels or laser therapy.

expert_tips: Consult a dermatologist to determine the underlying causes of large pores and develop an appropriate treatment plan.
Understand your skin type and tailor skincare products accordingly.
Be patient; results from treatments can take time, especially with severe cases.
